name: genesis-conductor-arbiter
description: arbiter: Hybrid scheduling for Genesis Conductor — bare-metal VRAM pinning (aSHARD) + quantum-accelerated Kubernetes orchestration by Igor Holt (@invariantx). Unified control plane bridging low-level hardware management and cloud-native scheduling for high-performance computing environments. Features infrastructure awareness for bare-metal resources, VRAM optimization eliminating GPU memory fragmentation via aSHARD pinning, next-gen quantum-accelerated algorithms for complex K8s workloads. Experimental production-grade orchestration layer for thermodynamic AI, Yennefer/Diamond-V/GPU clusters, and autonomous agent infrastructure in the Genesis Conductor Engine. Composes with openclaw-skills (grok-persistent-state for scheduling memory, mcp-openclaw-bridge for exposing arbiter tools) and vivarium simulations for reliable multi-node agent deployments.
